findings.message: 1 line in "Can you get a short extension?" has no quote from the guideline ("You can get one only if all three of these are true:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "What happens next" have no quote from the guideline ("Keep track of your evidence deadline."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
